from simulation import build
from runtime import solve, realize


def render(run, rng):
    initial = run["initial"]
    final = run["final"]
    events = run["events"]
    borrowed = initial["museum.borrowed_id"]
    borrowed_name = run["entities"][borrowed]["name"]
    mark = initial[borrowed + ".mark"]
    request = initial["owner_elsie.request"]

    opening_choices = [
        f"At the quiet end of the town museum, Ada and Bo were preparing a new exhibit called The Museum of Small Things. Their borrowed {borrowed_name} waited among old objects, carrying a story that was too small to shout and too interesting to ignore. Pip the magpie cocked his head from a shelf. “Let’s make people look closely,” Bo said. Ada nodded, but Mara the keeper tapped the case. “Closely—and respectfully.”",
        f"The museum gallery was peaceful except for Pip’s bright little clicks and Bo’s grand whispering. Ada had found a borrowed {borrowed_name} for their Museum of Small Things, while old objects rested nearby like sleepy clues. “A centerpiece!” Bo announced. “A carefully understood centerpiece,” Ada corrected. Mara smiled. “That difference is where good exhibits begin.”",
    ]

    paragraphs = [{
        "text": rng.choice(opening_choices),
        "event_ids": [],
        "kind": "beginning",
    }]

    names = {
        "inspect_borrowed_object": (
            f"Ada examined the borrowed {borrowed_name} without picking it up. "
            f"She noticed that its condition was {initial[borrowed + '.condition']}. "
            f"“It has been looked after,” she said, “so we must keep looking after it.”"
        ),
        "pip_notices_mark": (
            f"Pip hopped nearer and spotted a tiny {mark} on the {borrowed_name}. "
            f"He gave an excited, careful chirp, pointing with one glossy wing rather than grabbing. "
            f"Bo leaned in. “Even the smallest mark can be a clue.”"
        ),
        "pip_shares_mark": (
            f"Pip showed Ada the mark he had found on the {borrowed_name}. "
            f"Ada listened to his chirps and studied the place he indicated. “A family or maker’s mark,” "
            f"she said. “We should put only what we truly know on the label.”"
        ),
        "read_owner_letter": (
            f"At the worktable, Mara opened Elsie’s letter and read it aloud with Ada. "
            f"Elsie’s request was clear: she wanted the object to be {request}. "
            f"Bo blinked. “So the owner gets a say, even when our idea is exciting?” "
            f“Mara nodded. “Especially then.”"
        ),
        "test_display_case": (
            "Bo tested the display case while Mara watched its shelves and corners. "
            f"He discovered that the case was {initial['display_case.space']}. "
            f"“My dramatic arrangement may be dramatically crowded,” he admitted. Mara handed him a measuring glance. "
            f"“A good display leaves room for the objects—and for visitors’ eyes.”"
        ),
        "clear_case_space": (
            "With Ada and Pip helping, Bo removed the extra objects from the crowded case and returned them to the gallery. "
            "The shelves gained breathing room. Bo sighed at the emptier case, then grinned. "
            "“It is less busy,” he said. “Which means the important thing can finally speak.”"
        ),
        "lend_velvet_pad": (
            "Mara lent Ada the velvet pad. Ada accepted it with both hands and set it on the worktable. "
            "“This is not decoration,” Mara explained. “It is a promise that the borrowed object will not be scraped.” "
            "Ada nodded solemnly. “A soft promise.”"
        ),
        "lend_lamp": (
            "Mara lent Bo the small lamp. He carried it slowly, keeping its cord clear of the case. "
            "“Light can help people notice,” Bo said. “But not if it makes heat or glare.” "
            "Mara answered, “Then aim it like a question, not a shout.”"
        ),
        "prepare_padded_display": (
            f"Ada placed the {borrowed_name} on the velvet pad while Bo watched the edges and empty space. "
            "Nothing scraped or wobbled. The borrowed treasure became the focus of the case, resting securely instead of being squeezed among its neighbors. "
            "Bo whispered, “Now it looks important because we cared for it.”"
        ),
        "prepare_lit_display": (
            f"Bo aimed the small lamp and Ada carefully placed the {borrowed_name} in the roomy case. "
            "The light caught its little surface without glaring into visitors’ eyes. "
            "Pip tilted his head approvingly. “Not flashy,” Ada said. “Just enough for the mark to be seen.”"
        ),
        "prepare_key_exhibit": (
            "Because Elsie wanted her borrowed treasure home, the team changed the centerpiece. "
            "They set the worn old key in the roomy case and turned it so its locksmith mark faced outward. "
            "Bo looked at the empty space beside it. “An absence can tell part of a story too,” Ada said."
        ),
        "return_borrowed_object": (
            f"Mara and Ada placed the borrowed {borrowed_name} in the returning box. "
            "They carried it carefully toward the courtyard, where it could go back to Elsie. "
            "Bo watched the box leave and said, “Returning it is not giving up.” "
            "“No,” said Ada. “It is finishing the borrowing properly.”"
        ),
        "write_accurate_label": (
            f"Ada and Bo wrote the label only after Ada had learned the {borrowed_name}’s mark and Elsie’s request. "
            f"They named the mark and explained the owner’s wish instead of pretending the museum owned everything it displayed. "
            "Pip pecked once beside the finished card. Mara read it and smiled. “Accurate—and kind.”"
        ),
        "stabilize_arrangement": (
            "Bo checked the arrangement from several angles while Ada held the case steady. "
            "The centerpiece had space, the label was clear, and nothing leaned against anything fragile. "
            "Bo gave the shelf a tiny, careful test. It stayed still. “Stable,” he announced. “That is my favorite kind of impressive.”"
        ),
        "open_small_things_exhibit": (
            "Mara opened the Museum of Small Things. The case stood ready: labeled, balanced, and honest about what belonged there. "
            "Ada, Bo, and Pip stood back together as the first visitors approached. "
            "“Look closely,” Ada invited. “And remember that small things may have owners, marks, and wishes of their own.”"
        ),
    }

    for event in events:
        scene = event["scene"]
        text = names.get(scene, event["summary"] + ".")
        if scene == "open_small_things_exhibit":
            text += " " + (
                f"Inside, the {borrowed_name} caught the lamp beside its label."
                if final["museum.resolution"] == "displayed"
                else "Inside, the old key caught the light beside an empty outlined space where the borrowed treasure had been."
            )
        paragraphs.append({
            "text": text,
            "event_ids": [event["id"]],
            "kind": "scene",
        })

    if final["museum.resolution"] == "displayed":
        ending = (
            f"By closing time, the borrowed {borrowed_name} rested safely in the case, "
            "and its small mark glimmered beside the owner’s request. Visitors bent close without touching. "
            "Bo’s grand plan had become something better: a bright, balanced exhibit that made room for another person’s treasure and voice."
        )
    else:
        ending = (
            f"By closing time, Elsie’s {borrowed_name} was safely on its way home in the returning box. "
            "The old key held the center of the open case, while an empty outline showed visitors what had been lent and returned. "
            "Ada liked that the exhibit did not hide the change. Its most important object was the promise they had kept."
        )

    paragraphs.append({
        "text": ending,
        "event_ids": [events[-1]["id"]],
        "kind": "ending",
    })
    return paragraphs


def generate(seed, prose_seed=None):
    return realize(
        solve(build(seed), seed),
        render,
        seed if prose_seed is None else prose_seed,
    )
